fields.subject: FW: Request for approval to initiate verification plan per RCECD-OPS-2026, Section 5, T-2 Contain
fields.note: Director, I’ve completed the forensic image capture of CAD-MDS01 and confirmed isolation via REC-01 (RCECD-F-21). The last clean backup (2025-12-31 23:59) is on the network share but blocked by firewall due to missing CJIS incident report submission. I’m requesting formal authorization to begin the verification plan under RCECD-OPS-2026, Section 5, T-2 Contain, and to approve the vendor access request for restore. The 17 calls with corrupted ALI data must be reconciled via radio logs, run cards, and 24-hour audit of unit movements before any restoration. This is time-sensitive — we cannot risk restoring unverified data.
fields.signature:
Brent Harlow
911 Systems Manager
Rook County Emergency Communications District

original.subject: Request for approval to initiate verification plan per RCECD-OPS-2026, Section 5, T-2 Contain
original.body:
FROM: Brent Harlow, 911 Systems Manager
TO: Karen Voss, 911 Director
SUBJECT: Request for approval to initiate verification plan per RCECD-OPS-2026, Section 5, T-2 Contain

Background: CAD-MDS01 forensic image preserved on REC-01. Last clean backup (2025-12-31 23:59) exists but is blocked by firewall due to missing vendor access request. The 17 calls with corrupted ALI data must be reconciled via radio logs, run cards, and 24-hour audit of unit movements before any restoration.

Request: Authorization to begin verification plan and to approve vendor access request for restore.
